function.name: code_run
function.description: Run a short Python or shell script.

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read a file or list a directory. Workspace paths are allowed; outside-workspace paths require an independent per-read authorization. Supports keyword search with context lines.

keyword.description: Case-insensitive keyword to search. Returns matching lines with context.

function.name: file_search
function.description: Search the current workspace file index by path, keyword content, and optional semantic chunks. Use this to locate candidate files quickly, then call file_read before relying on exact content or modifying files.

query.description: Keyword, symbol, or path fragment to search for.

root.description: Optional workspace-relative directory to search. Must stay inside the workspace.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to 20; capped at 100.

refresh.description: When true, rescan changed files before searching. First search creates the index automatically.

path_only.description: When true, search only file names and paths, not file contents.

mode.description: Search mode. Defaults to hybrid. path_only=true forces keyword mode.

function.name: file_patch
function.description: Replace unique old content in a file with new content.

old_content.description: Existing content that must match exactly once.

function.name: file_delete
function.description: Delete a file or, when recursive is true, a directory inside the workspace. Always asks the user for explicit authorization before deleting. Outside-workspace deletion is not supported.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to delete.

recursive.description: Set true only to delete a directory recursively.

function.name: web_scan
function.description: Observe browser state. Returns tab sessions plus a compressed page snapshot. Prefer one broad scan, then use web_execute_js for precise DOM queries.

url.description: Optional URL to navigate to. Omit to scan the current or selected session.

session_id.description: Optional stable tab session id returned by web_scan.

mode.description: summary returns visible text plus key controls; elements returns interactive elements; simplified_html returns compressed HTML; text returns visible text only.

max_chars.description: Maximum content characters to return. Defaults to 8000.

function.name: web_execute_js
function.description: Execute JavaScript in a browser tab session. Use JS as the unified action/query language; save long results to file.

session_id.description: Optional stable tab session id returned by web_scan. Omit for current active tab.

timeout.description: Execution timeout in seconds. Defaults to 10.

save_to_file.description: If set, save the full JS result under the workspace and return only path, bytes, and summary.

no_monitor.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Set true to skip navigation diagnostics.

await_navigation.description: Whether to report navigation/reload diagnostics. Defaults to true.

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Interrupt and request user input. Provide options when the user should choose from known answers; omit options for free-form input.

message.description: Question or clarification for the user.

options.description: Optional answer choices to present to the user. When omitted, the user can type a free-form answer.

function.name: agent_delegate
function.description: Delegate a bounded sub-task to an enabled member of the active Agent team. Use only when the member's role fits the sub-task; execution is serial and returns the member's final result.

task.description: Specific sub-task for the member agent to complete.

context.description: Optional concise leader context needed by the member.

expected_output.description: Optional expected result format or acceptance criteria.

function.name: update_working_checkpoint
function.description: Update short-term working memory (key_info and related_sop). Updated content is injected into every subsequent turn.

key_info.description: Key information to remember for the current task.

function.name: start_long_term_update
function.description: Trigger a long-term memory settlement. Reads the SOP and instructs the agent to submit reviewed-source findings through memory_propose; it does not write active memory.

function.name: memory_propose
function.description: Submit a bounded long-term memory candidate for separate review. The candidate is quarantined and is not active memory.

content.description: Concise candidate fact, decision, or reusable procedure.

confidence.description: Confidence supported by the cited sources.

source_refs.description: Bounded source identifiers that allow a reviewer to verify the candidate.

function.name: skill_activate
function.description: Activate one or more local prompt skills by name. This only loads skill instructions into future turns; it does not execute code or register new tools.

names.description: Skill names to activate. Use names from the available skills list.

reason.description: Why these skills are useful for the current task.

function.name: plan_update
function.description: Read or overwrite plan.md in the task directory. Use this for long-horizon tasks to maintain a visible plan that survives across turns. Call with no args to read; pass `content` to overwrite the full file. The system will periodically inject a plan preview as alignment reminder.

content.description: Full markdown content to write. Omit this field to read current plan.md instead.
